note: GFP recreation area on Lake Oahe 9 miles west of Akaska, on open prairie bluffs: an East campground (sites 1E-8E) near the entrance and a West campground (9E-23E) about 600 m further on above the boat ramp, with three tent-only sites beyond it. Two boat ramps and a fish cleaning station. Between Oct. 1 and April 30 showers, flush toilets and water may be shut off; vault toilets usually stay open. --Claude
